charts.title: WASP-104 b: orbits around WASP-104
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-104's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-104 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Chen et al. 2021 (2021MNRAS.500.5420C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CHEN_ET_AL_2021): P 1.75540563 d

charts.title: WASP-104 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-104 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (45, 46) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 393495970, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
